value.rationale: The two-parameter Cartesian product of stars is a natural family of tree products with four non-equivalent edge orbits, and its canonical Banach operator norms are not determined solely by simple symmetry. Exact maximizer comparison yields distinct phase boundaries for cut and cycle projections, infinitely many graphs where the maximizing edge direction differs between complements, and sharp unattained global constants 5 and 6. These are nontrivial structural and parameter-optimality phenomena supported by all-parameter proof and not just small numeric improvements.
